sectors.trend: Mixed. Iron ore sentiment weak ('roaches seeth'), but rare earths (Lindian, Barkly NT) and gold (Great Southern, Kaiser) show strong project momentum. WA by-election loss adds policy uncertainty for MinRes.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore demand. Rare earths names (LRE.AX, BKY.AX) and gold juniors (GSG.AX, KGR.AX) offer thematic upside. WA political shift may delay resource approvals.

sectors.trend: Oil surge on US-Iran strike lifts upstream sentiment. Beetaloo gas flows to NT grid; Danish wind farm entry signals renewable re-engagement. Oil giant retreats on clean energy, showing investor pressure limits.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Gas names (SGH.AX, GNC.AX) gain from NT grid connection. Renewables (IDX.AX, LEM.AX) see modest positive from Danish investment.

sectors.trend: Property investor credit crash post-budget tax changes pressures bank lending volumes. Star's $307m loss and auditor doubts create credit overhang. Insurance cash-settlement controversy (ASIC) adds reputational risk. Macquarie/KPMG $700m audit bid signals M&A activity.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from property credit contraction. Insurance names (WBC.AX, CGU.AX) face regulatory scrutiny. Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid is a positive catalyst.

sectors.trend: Housing values decline sharply in August; auction sentiment crumbles. Negative gearing reform 'fails to ignite' but renter relief emerges. Property developer distress (Bathla, Star) signals sector stress.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential property developers at elevated default risk. Renter relief may support long-term demand.

sectors.trend: Weight-loss drug (GLP-1) demand surges; EV uptake accelerates; 'dupe' brand trend grows. Qantas strike vote threatens air travel. Small business resilience narrative persists.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX see mixed signals. QAN.AX faces strike risk. GLP-1 theme benefits healthcare supply chains. Consumer staples defensive appeal rises in risk-off.

sectors.trend: Central banker warns AI could trigger global downturn; Meta $24b settlement looms; NSW HSC AI crackdown signals regulatory tightening. US tech (Nvidia, Marvell, Zoom) shows bifurcated performance.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face sentiment overhang from AI contagion fears. Meta settlement may pressure global ad-tech. Defensive positioning warranted.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to slip 1-2% on oil-driven risk-off and housing data. ^AXJO under pressure from weak iron ore sentiment. Energy and gold outperform. Qantas strike and Star distress add idiosyncratic risk. RBA rate expectation shift keeps financials under pressure. 1-3 month outlook: cautious, range-bound with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook stabilises if Middle East de-escalates and RBA pivots to cuts. Critical minerals pipeline (rare earths, uranium, phosphate) offers structural alpha. Housing correction may bottom by H2 2026, supporting REIT recovery. Energy transition (gas-to-grid, wind) provides medium-term growth. Key variable: whether oil shock feeds into persistent inflation, delaying RBA easing.
